previous_statement: By the root statement definition of halo-robust invisible mass, sigma_g is the positive coefficient mass row v places on rows at l1-distance greater than tau/4 from C, where tau=sqrt(delta); hence sigma_g=sum_{d_j>tau/4} a_j^+.
new_statement: Let C=conv{p_w:w in W(P)}. For each row index j put d_j=dist_1(p_j,C), a_j=P_{vj}, and a_j^+=max(a_j,0), and put tau=sqrt(delta). The root statement defines sigma_g as the halo-robust invisible mass, i.e. the positive coefficient mass row v places on rows at ell-1 distance greater than tau/4 from conv W; therefore sigma_g=sum_{j:dist_1(p_j,C)>tau/4} max(P_{vj},0)=sum_{d_j>tau/4} a_j^+.
